verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo confirms an open-source branch with a prebuilt container image (bundling headless Chrome, LibreOffice, CJK fonts) that developers can run without building it themselves, directly enabling self-hosting instead of relying on the hosted r.jina.ai service; the SaaS proxy is explicitly optional via 'x-proxy: auto'. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment and detailed self-host setup/config docs beyond the container image mention.
